meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
Haan 😊 India mein online **women’s kurta sets** ke liye main in brands ko consider karungi:

- **BIBA** — reliable quality, everyday cotton se festive sets tak. Current collection mein 1,300+ kurta-set styles hain. [www.biba.in](https://www.biba.in/kurta-sets/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **W for Woman** — office wear aur polished, elegant sets ke liye especially achha. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Aurelia** — comfortable everyday wear + thoda dressy look; cotton sets ke liye good option. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Libas** — trendy prints, affordable range aur daily/occasion dono ke liye kaafi variety. [www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Fabindia** — agar aapko understated, hand-crafted/timeless Indian look pasand hai. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Soch** — thoda more traditional/festive styling ke liye.
- **Janasya** — budget-friendly, pretty prints aur festive-looking sets ke liye. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/guides/best-kurta-brands-women-under-2000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar mujhe 3 choose karne ho:
**Daily wear:** Aurelia / Libas  
**Office:** W for Woman / BIBA  
**Festive:** BIBA / Soch / Fabindia  

Agar aap mujhe **budget (₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000), age group, size aur occasion** bata do, main uske hisaab se **exact kurta sets** shortlist kar sakti hoon.
